WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(REQ_UNIT),0) REQ_UNIT_TGT
,isnull(sum(REQ_AMOUNT),0) REQ_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(ACQ_UNIT),0) ACQ_UNIT_TGT
,isnull(sum(ACQ_AMOUNT  ),0) ACQ_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(TRN_TAX_AMOUNT),0) TRN_TAX_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(TDS_AMOUNT),0) TDS_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(NET_AMOUNT),0) NET_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(TRAN_GAIN_LOSS),0) TRAN_GAIN_LOSS_TGT
,isnull(sum(LOAD_AMT),0) LOAD_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(VAT_AMT),0) VAT_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(BROKER_COMM_AMT),0) BROKER_COMM_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(AMC_COMM_AMT),0) AMC_COMM_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(REMITTANCE_CHARGE),0) REMITTANCE_CHARGE_TGT
,isnull(sum(OTHER_CHARGE_1),0) OTHER_CHARGE_1_TGT
,isnull(sum(OTHER_CHARGE_2),0) OTHER_CHARGE_2_TGT
,isnull(sum(OTHER_CHARGE_3),0) OTHER_CHARGE_3_TGT
,isnull(sum(OTHER_CHARGE_4),0) OTHER_CHARGE_4_TGT
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVE_REMITTANCE_CHARGE)),0) WAIVE_REMITTANCE_CHARGE_TGT
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_1)),0) WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_1_TGT
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_2)),0) WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_2_TGT
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_3)),0) WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_3_TGT
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_4)),0) WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_4_TGT
,isnull(sum(GROSS_UNIT),0) GROSS_UNIT_TGT
,isnull(sum(GROSS_AMOUNT),0) GROSS_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(AMOUNT_DISBURSED),0) AMOUNT_DISBURSED_TGT
,isnull(sum(ORIGINAL_LOAD_AMT),0) ORIGINAL_LOAD_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(DISCOUNT_AMOUNT),0) DISCOUNT_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(BROKER_APPOR_VALUE),0) BROKER_APPOR_VALUE_TGT
,isnull(sum(AMC_APPOR_VALUE),0) AMC_APPOR_VALUE_TGT
,isnull(sum(PRS_PENALTY_AMOUNT),0) PRS_PENALTY_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(PAYABLE_AMOUNT),0) PAYABLE_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(RECEIVABLE_AMOUNT),0) RECEIVABLE_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(PERFORMANCE_FEE),0) PERFORMANCE_FEE_TGT
,isnull(sum(MARGIN_FINANCE_AMT),0) MARGIN_FINANCE_AMT_TGT
,isnull(sum(DD_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT),0) DD_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(DD_INTEREST_AMOUNT),0) DD_INTEREST_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(DD_CATCHUP_FEE_AMOUNT),0) DD_CATCHUP_FEE_AMOUNT_TGT
,isnull(sum(DD_CATCHUP_SERVICE_TAX_AMOUNT),0) DD_CATCHUP_SERVICE_TAX_AMOUNT_TGT
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_UITFTRANMST WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,

,TRN_TAX_AMOUNT_TGT
,TDS_AMOUNT_TGT
,NET_AMOUNT_TGT
,TRAN_GAIN_LOSS_TGT
,LOAD_AMT_TGT
,VAT_AMT_TGT
,BROKER_COMM_AMT_TGT
,AMC_COMM_AMT_TGT
,REMITTANCE_CHARGE_TGT
,OTHER_CHARGE_1_TGT
,OTHER_CHARGE_2_TGT
,OTHER_CHARGE_3_TGT
,OTHER_CHARGE_4_TGT
,WAIVE_REMITTANCE_CHARGE_TGT
,WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_1_TGT
,WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_2_TGT
,WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_3_TGT
,WAIVE_OTHER_CHARGE_4_TGT
,GROSS_UNIT_TGT
,GROSS_AMOUNT_TGT
,AMOUNT_DISBURSED_TGT
,ORIGINAL_LOAD_AMT_TGT
,DISCOUNT_AMOUNT_TGT
,BROKER_APPOR_VALUE_TGT
,AMC_APPOR_VALUE_TGT
,PRS_PENALTY_AMOUNT_TGT
,PAYABLE_AMOUNT_TGT
,RECEIVABLE_AMOUNT_TGT
,PERFORMANCE_FEE_TGT
,MARGIN_FINANCE_AMT_TGT
,DD_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT_TGT
,DD_INTEREST_AMOUNT_TGT
,DD_CATCHUP_FEE_AMOUNT_TGT
,DD_CATCHUP_SERVICE_TAX_AMOUNT_TGT

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)
